notes:
«تصميم» in a measurement check: each X keeps the design's own value [skip ci]

The owner: when the XML's value is outside the range set for it, take the
design's value «without typing a number». In «فحص القياسات», the formula
«تصميم» (also «التصميم», «design»): with From … to, only when the XML value
is outside them or missing; without them, always. The measurement is not
sent — every X it fills keeps its value in the design file, and follows it
when the design changes. Shown in the order as «التصميم» with a note
«FL: قيمة التصميم نفسه (في XML: …)»; the rules mark it «design», so neither
«missing» nor «would keep the design's value» holds the order.

ar: الكلمة «تصميم» في فحص القياسات: يأخذ كل X قيمته من ملف التصميم
